situations.headline: Centerspace to be acquired by Independence Realty Trust in stock/OP-unit merger

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: Centerspace to be acquired by Independence Realty Trust in stock/OP-unit merger (interest 7, risk 4)

thesis.text: Centerspace is now a merger-arbitrage situation following its September 8, 2026 definitive agreement to be acquired by Independence Realty Trust via a stock/OP-unit combination structured to qualify as a tax-free reorganization; deal completion is contingent on shareholder votes, lender consents on designated loans, and other Article VII closing conditions, with Parent retaining discretion to defer closing near the End Date — future 8-Ks (S-4/proxy filing, exchange ratio detail, termination fee terms, and any competing bids) should be monitored closely given the escalated item disclosure.
